title: Build within-class and between-class scatter
description: You measure feature variation around class means and the overall mean.

steps.description: You group rows by their class labels and store each class mean and count. Both returned arrays follow np.unique(y) order.
You weight class means by their counts to compute mu. Sw accumulates feature deviations around each class's own mean, called within-class scatter.

steps.question: How does class size affect each contribution to Sb?
steps.answer: counts[c] multiplies the outer product of the class mean's displacement from mu. Larger classes therefore receive greater weight for the same displacement.

steps.description: You return Sb, the between-class scatter, with Sw and the supporting statistics. The recording shows both scatter matrices have shape (4,4).
